author: arbitron
description: Multi-persona PR review pipeline (Architect R1 -> 10x R1 -> Architect R2 -> 10x R2 -> Security -> Manager) with optional senior-engineer auto-implement of selected fix tier. Intended to be triggered by a GitHub Action on PR open/update.

inputs.description: GitHub repo in owner/name format (e.g. dbinky/arbitron). Must be cloned into ~/Repos/<owner>/<name> on the container host.
inputs.name: repo

inputs.description: Auto-implement tier. One of: must, must-should, all-but-defer, none. 'none' skips the senior-engineer node entirely.
inputs.name: fix_scope

name: pr-review

nodes.description: Ivory Tower Architect first pass; posts inline + general comments
nodes.label: Architect R1

nodes.description: 10x GSD Engineer first pass; replies to architect threads, adds practical findings
nodes.label: 10x R1

nodes.description: Architect second pass; concedes or doubles down in existing threads only
nodes.label: Architect R2

nodes.description: 10x second pass; final positions in existing threads
nodes.label: 10x R2

nodes.description: Security expert; weighs in on existing debates and posts severity-tagged findings
nodes.label: Security

nodes.description: Engineering manager; per-thread decisions + Decision Summary with verdict
nodes.label: Manager

nodes.description: Implements selected fix tier locally on the PR branch; does NOT push (manual review before push)
nodes.label: Senior Engineer

nodes.description: No-op terminal node reached when fix_scope == 'none'
nodes.label: Skipped (review-only)
